definition: An item is COVERED when every piece of data it names has a home in the database as built (a fresh database: schema.sql, every delta, every seed): a table column (or a documented key of a JSON column), a registry row (attribute_def, setting_def, device_kind), a metric for its facts (and a source where the item is a feed), a device_action, a view, or a function of the planner read layer (src/core/planner-read.js) that derives it from stored facts. test/coverage-matrix.test.js checks that every target exists. Home Assistant wiring, presentation, fixed code rules and archived keys are EXCLUDED_NOT_DATA with a reason (catalogue section 5 and the Dir "rule" rows). Secret values are kept out of the database by design; the connection row that records them is the target. 100 % = every verified Predbat and PredHeat item that is data is covered: covered / (items - excluded), with the unverified items (PB-DIAG-04 and the 11 planning-design fields of Appendix A) counted apart.
